document.abstract: In addition to the continued development and maintenance of its suite of open technical specifications for the delivery of digital television and other broadband and broadcast services, the past year has seen the DVB Project intensifying activities that support the implementation of those specifications. With more than 130 member organizations spanning the media delivery value chain, DVB remains the global reference for interoperable standards that enable innovation while supporting existing business models.
